svg.title: After: local curve profiles, not filled sections / 作成後：塗りつぶしではなく局所的な断面曲線
svg.desc: A schematic seal contour, two sheet panel traces and a small extra solid contour. All are line-only intersection outputs. Sheet traces need not be closed. The dashed boundary is explanatory construction, not a required drafted outline.

g.text: Inspect every profile / 各断面の輪郭を確認
SCHEMATIC / 模式図 · Dashed window is explanatory only / 破線は切断範囲の説明用
Seal contour / シールの輪郭
Panel traces / パネルの交線
Other included body / その他の対象ボディ
No fill or hatch / 塗りつぶし・ハッチなし
Line contours, not filled regions / 輪郭線のみを作成。断面領域の塗りつぶしはありません
